name: line-upgrade
description: Three days on the raise mechanic (01 §4.2, 0.17). The starting MV line to Jasienica is raised to HV on turn 0: 382,5 mln zł (85% of a new HV line over the same 75 km) leaves the budget up front and 25 h of work follow, so the type flips at the end of turn 8. The corridor delivers the whole time on MV, and from turn 9 the recorded losses drop by half — the route's loss factor goes 2%/100 km → 1%/100 km. A second line is then built on the same route, its raise to MV ordered on turn 16 and cancelled on turn 18: the line stays LV and the money stays spent (§2.6).

actions.note: Enough generation that the route carries a measurable flow.
A second track on the same route — still a separate line (01 §7).
Abandoned mid-work: the line stays LV, the money is gone.
